name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Friends' titles no longer disappear and reappear when a friend's server drops offline and comes back. Previously every one of their movies and shows was deleted from your library on each outage and recreated on return, which looked like the server constantly re-adding its whole catalog and lost watch progress. Now existing titles stay in place (the web client still hides the ones that are currently unavailable) and only genuinely new titles wait for the server to return. Disabling a server still removes its titles.
